data.body_html:
Imagine cruising out of Puerto Banús as the sun dips behind La Concha, the sky turning shades of orange and pink over the Mediterranean. A marbella yacht charter puerto banus dinner cruise 2027 offers exactly that—a private evening on the water with dinner, drinks, and the glittering Costa del Sol coastline as your backdrop. Whether you're celebrating an anniversary, a birthday, or simply want a memorable night out, this guide covers everything from yacht options and pricing to sunset timing and catering.

Why Choose a Dinner Cruise from Puerto Banús?

Puerto Banús is the heart of Marbella's luxury scene, and a dinner cruise lets you experience it from the best seat in the house—the sea. You'll skip crowded restaurants and enjoy a private setting with your own skipper, drinks, and a custom itinerary. The marina's proximity to the open sea means you're anchoring in calm coves like Cala del Faro within minutes. Plus, with the 2027 season already seeing high demand, booking early ensures choice of the best yachts and dates.

Our Fleet for Evening Charters

We offer a range of yachts departing from Puerto Banús, all including a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. For a dinner cruise, we recommend:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h or €2,299/8h. Intimate and stylish.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – same tier pricing. Great for small groups.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – spacious flybridge for sunset lounging.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax, white or grey) – from €4,719/4h, includes a free jet ski.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – ultimate luxury for a special evening.

For larger groups, the Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) or Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax) offer ample dining space. Contact us via WhatsApp for pricing on these and other yachts.

Sunset Timing and Best Months

For a dinner cruise, you want to catch sunset over the water. In Marbella, sunset times vary by season:

  • June–August: Sunset around 21:30. Depart at 19:00–20:00 for a golden hour cruise.
  • September–October: Sunset 20:00–21:00. Start 17:00–18:00.
  • April–May: Sunset 20:00–21:00. Similar timing.

The best months for evening charters are May through October, when temperatures are warm (25–30°C) and seas are calm. Even in July and August, the evening breeze keeps things comfortable.

Sample Dinner Cruise Itinerary

A typical 3–4 hour evening cruise might look like this:

  1. 18:30 – Board at Puerto Banús. Meet your skipper, enjoy welcome drinks.
  2. 19:00 – Depart west toward Estepona. Cruise along the Golden Mile, past the Marbella Club and Puente Romano.
  3. 19:45 – Anchor at Cala Cortés or Cala del Faro. Swim in the calm cove, then enjoy dinner served on deck.
  4. 20:45 – Sunset views. Watch the sky change colours while dining.
  5. 21:30 – Return to Puerto Banús. Cruise back under the stars, with the marina lights ahead.

Your skipper can adjust the route—some prefer to head east toward Cabopino or stay near the bay for a shorter trip.

Catering Options for Your Dinner Cruise

You can bring your own food or arrange catering through us. Popular choices include:

  • Mediterranean seafood platter: grilled prawns, octopus, mussels, and fresh bread.
  • Paella: Valencian-style chicken or seafood paella, cooked and delivered hot.
  • Private chef: for a premium experience, a chef can prepare a multi-course meal onboard.

We also offer stops at waterfront restaurants in Puerto Banús or Estepona if you prefer to dine ashore. Just let us know your preferences when booking.

What to Bring and Wear

Evenings on the water can be cooler than expected, especially after sunset. Bring a light jacket or sweater. Comfortable shoes with non-slip soles are recommended. Don't forget sunscreen for the earlier part of the cruise, and a camera for the sunset. If you plan to swim, bring a towel and swimwear.
